sections.title: Urban Gardening Seminar Registration
sections.context: A man is enquiring about a community gardening seminar at a local community center.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Good morning! Welcome to the Riverside Community Centre. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: Hello. I saw a flyer outside about the upcoming seminar series on sustainable living. I'm particularly interested in the Urban Gardening session. Is it still possible to register?

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Yes, absolutely! We still have a few spots left for that one. It's been very popular this year. I just need to take down some details from you to get you registered. Can I start with your full name?

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: Sure, it’s Mark Harrison.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Is that Harrison with one 'r' or two?

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: It's double 'r'. H-A-R-R-I-S-O-N.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Great, thank you. And what is your current occupation, Mr. Harrison? We collect this for our demographic records.

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: I'm a high school teacher. I actually want to start a small garden project with my students next term.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: That sounds like a wonderful initiative! Now, I'll need a contact email address.

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: It’s mark.h84@webmail.com. That’s mark dot h eighty-four at webmail dot com.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Got it. And a phone number please?

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: Yes, it’s 0412 555 982... oh, wait, I’m sorry, I just changed my number recently. It’s actually 0412 555 983. I always get that last digit mixed up.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: No problem at all. I’ve updated that to 983 at the end. Now, the Urban Gardening seminar is running on two different days this weekend to accommodate more people. We have a session on Saturday morning and another one on Sunday afternoon. Which one would you prefer?

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: I have a faculty meeting on Saturday morning, so Sunday would be much better for me.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Perfect. Sunday afternoon it is. Now, I should give you some specific details about the event. Usually, our seminars are held in the Central Library, but due to some maintenance work there, this particular session has been moved to the North Community Hall.

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: North Community Hall? Is that the one near the park?

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: That’s the one. It’s a bit larger, which is good because we’re expecting a big crowd. The main focus of this seminar will be organic fertilizers and composting. The guest speaker is quite an expert on that.

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: Composting is exactly what I need to learn about for the school project. Is there anything I need to bring along?

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: We provide all the notebooks and pens. However, there is a practical segment where you'll be handling soil, so we suggest all participants bring their own pair of gloves. We have a few spares, but they might not be the right size.

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: I’ll make a note of that. Gloves. And what about the cost?

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: The standard registration fee is $30. However, since you're a resident in this postcode, you might be eligible for a discount if you have a community membership card.

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: I do have one! I joined last month.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: In that case, you get a 15% discount. That brings the total down to $25.50.

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: That’s great. Can I pay by credit card now?

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: I’m terribly sorry, our card terminal is actually down for repairs today. We can only accept cash at the desk, or you can pay online later this evening.

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: I actually have some cash on me, so I’ll just pay now to get it over with.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Excellent. Here is your receipt and a small map to the North Community Hall. We look forward to seeing you there on Sunday!

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: Thank you very much for your help.

questions.explanation: Mặc dù thường tổ chức ở Central Library, nhưng lần này chuyển sang North Community Hall.
Chủ đề chính của buổi hội thảo là phân bón hữu cơ và ủ phân (composting).

Do máy quẹt thẻ bị hỏng, Mark đã trả bằng tiền mặt (cash).
